[A571] STOP

Branch: `requirements-port`. Head: `18d737832c376f32660eb21fe2796e0b611507e3`.

The required base commit fails the unchanged privacy gate: `18d737832c376f32660eb21fe2796e0b611507e3: unexpected identity`. Its squash metadata differs from the gate policy. An identity-policy correction is outside this lane's assigned scope. No history, identity configuration or gate exception was changed.

The requirements port is prepared in the working tree. It adds 24 traced requirements, records all 114 numbered source dispositions and both Mark II decisions, and adds one independent ADP vector with eleven field defects. Traceability and inventory are regenerated.

All other gates pass: twelve preflight gates; GCC and Clang sanitizer builds/tests; 100% coverage after unchanged exclusions; all 322 mutation plants; report controls; static analysis; three graph renders; and RV32 Debug/Release link and smoke execution. The remaining hosted campaigns were run separately after the full validator stopped at privacy. Peak service memory stayed below 9 GB.

No commit was made because the all-gates-pass condition is unmet. HANDOFF.md, PR-BODY.md, the complete mapping, test/defect and target gate tables, artifact hashes, and the saved patch location are in the assigned output packet. Production sources and headers are unchanged. No push or pull request creation was performed.
